info.title: Smart Restaurant Campus API
info.description: Multi-tenant restaurant platform. Every business object belongs to one restaurant (tenant) and optionally one branch; money is an integer in tiyin (1 so'm = 100 tiyin); every failure is the one error envelope in three languages.

XTenant.name: X-Tenant
XTenant.description: Restaurant slug. Optional when the token already belongs to a restaurant — the token wins, and a header naming a different restaurant is tenant.mismatch. Required in production for tokens that belong to none.

XBranch.name: X-Branch
XBranch.description: Branch slug. Absent means every branch of the restaurant — an owner reading totals — not a missing value.

XLocale.name: X-Locale
XLocale.description: Wins over the user preference and Accept-Language.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key, one per operation. The same key replays the stored response verbatim (Idempotent-Replay: true); the same key with a different body is request.idempotency_key_reused.

field.description: Present when one input field is to blame.

retryable.description: True: same request may succeed later. False: change something first.

auth.forbidden.message_uz: Sizda bu amal uchun ruxsat yo'q. Menejerga murojaat qiling.
auth.forbidden.message_ru: У вас нет прав на это действие. Обратитесь к менеджеру.
auth.forbidden.message_en: You do not have permission for this. Ask a manager.

auth.invalid_credentials.message_en: Those sign-in details are not correct.

auth.pin_locked.message_uz: Hisob qulflandi. PIN ni menejer tiklaydi.
auth.pin_locked.message_ru: Учётная запись заблокирована. PIN сбрасывает менеджер.
auth.pin_locked.message_en: This account is locked. A manager must reset the PIN.

bots.invalid_token.message_en: That internal token is not valid.

bots.token_not_configured.message_ru: Внутренний токен для ботов не настроен.
bots.token_not_configured.message_en: The internal bot token is not configured.

branch.mismatch.message_uz: Siz boshqa filial ma'lumotiga kira olmaysiz.
branch.mismatch.message_ru: Вы не можете обращаться к данным другого филиала.
branch.mismatch.message_en: You cannot reach another branch's data.

module.disabled.message_ru: Этот модуль не подключён для ресторана.
module.disabled.message_en: This module is not enabled for the restaurant.

order.closed.message_uz: Bu hisob yopilgan — uni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.
order.closed.message_ru: Этот счёт закрыт — изменить его нельзя.
order.closed.message_en: This bill is closed and cannot be changed.

order.invalid_transition.message_ru: Заказ нельзя перевести в это состояние.
order.invalid_transition.message_en: The order cannot move to that state.

order.item_not_found.message_en: That dish is not on the menu.

plan.limit_exceeded.message_uz: Tarif chegarasiga yetdingiz. Tarifni ko'tarish kerak.
plan.limit_exceeded.message_ru: Достигнут предел тарифа. Нужно повысить тариф.
plan.limit_exceeded.message_en: You have reached the plan limit. Upgrade to continue.

pos.approval_closed.message_uz: Bu so'rovga allaqachon javob berilgan yoki muddati o'tgan.
pos.approval_closed.message_ru: На этот запрос уже ответили или он истёк.
pos.approval_closed.message_en: That request was already answered or has expired.

pos.approval_invalid.message_en: That approval token is not valid.

pos.approval_self.message_en: You cannot approve your own request.

pos.bill_refused.message_en: The bill could not be changed.

pos.drawer_refused.message_ru: Движение по кассе записать не удалось.
pos.drawer_refused.message_en: The drawer movement could not be recorded.

pos.no_open_shift.message_uz: Ochiq smena yo'q. Avval smenani oching.
pos.no_open_shift.message_ru: Нет открытой смены. Сначала откройте смену.
pos.no_open_shift.message_en: There is no open shift. Open one first.

pos.pin_mismatch.message_en: That current PIN is not correct.

pos.session_closed.message_ru: Сессия кассы не найдена или закрыта.
pos.session_closed.message_en: The till session is missing or closed.

pos.session_timeout.message_ru: Сессия закрыта из-за бездействия. Введите PIN.
pos.session_timeout.message_en: The session closed on inactivity. Enter your PIN.

pos.session_token_required.message_ru: Этот токен не привязан к сессии кассы.
pos.session_token_required.message_en: This token is not bound to a till session.

pos.shift_refused.message_en: The shift could not be changed.

pos.tender_refused.message_en: The payment could not be taken.

request.idempotency_key_missing.message_uz: Bu amal bir martalik kalitsiz qabul qilinmaydi.
request.idempotency_key_missing.message_ru: Эта операция не принимается без ключа идемпотентности.
request.idempotency_key_missing.message_en: This operation needs an idempotency key.

request.idempotency_key_reused.message_uz: Bu kalit boshqa so'rov uchun ishlatilgan. Yangi kalit bering.
request.idempotency_key_reused.message_ru: Этот ключ уже использован для другого запроса. Дайте новый ключ.
request.idempotency_key_reused.message_en: This key was already used for a different request. Send a new one.

request.method_not_allowed.message_uz: Bu manzil bu turdagi so'rovni qabul qilmaydi.
request.method_not_allowed.message_ru: Этот адрес не принимает такой запрос.
request.method_not_allowed.message_en: This endpoint does not accept that method.

request.not_found.message_en: The requested record was not found.

request.rate_limited.message_uz: Juda ko'p urinish. Biroz kutib, qaytadan urinib ko'ring.
request.rate_limited.message_ru: Слишком много попыток. Подождите немного и повторите.
request.rate_limited.message_en: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

request.validation_failed.message_uz: Yuborilgan ma'lumot to'g'ri emas. Belgilangan maydonni tekshiring.
request.validation_failed.message_ru: Отправленные данные неверны. Проверьте отмеченное поле.
request.validation_failed.message_en: The submitted data is not valid. Check the highlighted field.

server.unavailable.message_uz: Xizmat vaqtincha ishlamayapti. Ishlashda davom eting — amal navbatga yozildi.
server.unavailable.message_ru: Сервис временно недоступен. Продолжайте работать — операция в очереди.
server.unavailable.message_en: The service is temporarily unavailable. Keep working — the action is queued.

server.unexpected.message_uz: Kutilmagan xatolik. Iltimos, qaytadan urinib ko'ring.
server.unexpected.message_en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

stock.insufficient.message_uz: Ombor qoldig'idan ko'p chiqim qilib bo'lmaydi.
stock.insufficient.message_ru: Нельзя списать больше, чем есть на складе.
stock.insufficient.message_en: You cannot deplete more than the stock on hand.

tenant.mismatch.message_uz: Siz boshqa restoran ma'lumotiga kira olmaysiz.
tenant.mismatch.message_ru: Вы не можете обращаться к данным другого ресторана.
tenant.mismatch.message_en: You cannot reach another restaurant's data.

tenant.required.message_en: No restaurant could be resolved for this request.
